title: Opening a site's workspace page is a visit: tracy-web records one site.entered per person, site and half hour, never for a fetch
steps: S1: A seated person navigates (Accept text/html) to /<site>/ twice, then fetches it with Accept application/json.
S2: The clock moves on by half an hour; the person navigates again.
expect: S1: one ops_signal site.entered for that site, carrying the person's address and nothing else.
S2: a second one; the dedupe key does not depend on the address's case.
evidence: Plan tasks/todo-do-dung-that.md U3; council 17/10/2026: only a first visit cannot measure a return on another day
fence: Never awaited by the page; one per half hour so a reload is not a visit

tests: workspaceRoutes: a navigation to a site workspace records site.entered
